sections.title: Welcome to Pairs of Linear Equations
learning_goals: Get an overview of what pairs of linear equations are and why they are important.

sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Understand the general form of linear equations in two variables.
Learn to create equations from word problems.
Explore graphical solutions and their interpretations.
Master algebraic methods: substitution and elimination.
Identify conditions for unique, no, or infinitely many solutions.
Apply these concepts to solve real-world problems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary of learning objectives with avatar and bullet points.

sections.title: Defining Linear Equations and Their General Form
learning_goals: Define what constitutes a pair of linear equations in two variables.
Identify the components of the general form (ax + by + c = 0).
Understand how to represent real-world scenarios as linear equations.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for displaying mathematical definitions, equations, and showing the structure of the general form with coefficients and variables.

sections.title: Graphical Solutions: Intersecting, Parallel, and Coincident Lines
learning_goals: Interpret the solution of a pair of linear equations graphically.
Distinguish between intersecting, parallel, and coincident lines.
Relate graphical outcomes to consistent, inconsistent, and dependent systems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can effectively animate the plotting of lines, showing their intersection points, parallelism, or coincidence to illustrate solution types.

sections.title: Algebraic Methods: Substitution and Elimination
learning_goals: Apply the substitution method to solve pairs of linear equations step-by-step.
Apply the elimination method to solve pairs of linear equations step-by-step.
Compare the efficiency of substitution and elimination for different problem types.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is excellent for demonstrating step-by-step algebraic processes, highlighting variable isolation and coefficient manipulation.

sections.title: Predicting Solution Types Using Coefficient Ratios
learning_goals: Use the ratios of coefficients to predict if a system has a unique solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions.
Connect coefficient ratios to the graphical representation of lines (intersecting, parallel, coincident).
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can visually present the coefficient ratios and animate how they correspond to different graphical outcomes and solution types.

sections.title: Case Study: Solving a Real-World Word Problem
learning_goals: Translate a word problem into a pair of linear equations.
Apply learned algebraic methods to solve a practical problem.
Interpret the solution in the context of the original word problem.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can be used to display the word problem, then animate the process of setting up equations and solving them, making the application clear.

sections.title: Test Your Knowledge!
learning_goals: Recall definitions and general forms of linear equations.
Practice solving linear equations graphically and algebraically.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style quiz with questions and answers displayed sequentially.

sections.title: Key Takeaways: Pairs of Linear Equations
learning_goals: Review the core concepts of linear equations in two variables.
Reinforce understanding of graphical and algebraic solution methods.
Remember the conditions for different types of solutions.
